Technical Details:

The LangGraph agent is designed to understand and respond to questions about web page content. It can classify queries, maintain conversation history, and provide intelligent responses based on the page context.

Features:

  • Query classification (search, analysis, summary, explanation)
  • Conversation history management
  • Thread-based conversation persistence
  • Context-aware responses
  • Error handling and fallback mechanisms
